N = int(input())

MOD = 1000000007

class Number:
    def __init__(self, v=0):
        if v < 0:
            v %= MOD
            v += MOD
        if v >= MOD:
            v %= MOD
        self.val = v

    @staticmethod
    def inverse(a, m=MOD):
        g, r, x, y = m, a, 0, 1
        while r != 0:
            q = g // r
            g, r = r, g % r
            x, y = y, x - q * y
        return x if x >= 0 else x + m

    def __int__(self):
        return self.val

    def __iadd__(self, other):
        self.val += other.val
        if self.val >= MOD:
            self.val -= MOD
        return self

    def __isub__(self, other):
        self.val -= other.val
        if self.val < 0:
            self.val += MOD
        return self

    @staticmethod
    def fast_mod(x, m=MOD):
        return x % m

    def __imul__(self, other):
        self.val = self.fast_mod(self.val * other.val)
        return self

    def __itruediv__(self, other):
        return self.__imul__(Number(self.inverse(other.val)))

    def __add__(self, other):
        res = Number(self.val)
        res += other
        return res

    def __sub__(self, other):
        res = Number(self.val)
        res -= other
        return res

    def __mul__(self, other):
        res = Number(self.val)
        res *= other
        return res

    def __truediv__(self, other):
        res = Number(self.val)
        res /= other
        return res

    def __neg__(self):
        return Number(0) if self.val == 0 else Number(MOD - self.val)

    def inv(self):
        return Number(self.inverse(self.val))

    def pow(self, p):
        assert p >= 0
        base = Number(self.val)
        result = Number(1)
        while p > 0:
            if p & 1:
                result *= base
            base *= base
            p >>= 1
        return result

prob = [[Number() for _ in range(N)] for _ in range(N)]
for i in range(N):
    row = list(map(int, input().split()))
    for j in range(N):
        p = row[j]
        prob[i][j] = Number(p) / Number(100)

from collections import defaultdict

state_map = {}
init_mask = [False] * (1 << N)
init_mask[0] = True
state_map[tuple(init_mask)] = Number(1)

for left_idx in range(N):
    new_state_map = defaultdict(lambda: Number(0))
    for mask_curr in range(1 << N):
        product = Number(1)
        for right_idx in range(N):
            if (mask_curr >> right_idx) & 1:
                product *= prob[left_idx][right_idx]
            else:
                product *= Number(1) - prob[left_idx][right_idx]
        for possible_mask_tuple, prob_value in list(state_map.items()):
            possible_mask = list(possible_mask_tuple)
            temp_mask = [False] * (1 << N)
            for m in range(1 << N):
                if possible_mask[m]:
                    for i in range(N):
                        if ((mask_curr >> i) & 1) != 0 and ((m >> i) & 1) == 0:
                            temp_mask[m | (1 << i)] = True
            temp_mask_tuple = tuple(temp_mask)
            new_state_map[temp_mask_tuple] += prob_value * product
    state_map = new_state_map

total = Number()
for p_mask, p_value in state_map.items():
    if p_mask[(1 << N) - 1]:
        total += p_value

print(int(total))
